# Pulse task #2909: Reconcile current Hex architecture and capability orientation

Operation: 4b590bbe5a0d7cf297413c3707d0d44c
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

PROPOSED — audit/planning only, awaiting user implementation approval. Goal7; baseline b05a9eaa61edc60f711acdc06d907f7525d6197c. Consolidated findings A01/F01. Priority Medium; confidence High; risk Low.

Problem: current orientation contradicts owning source and itself, making onboarding and safe extension harder. https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/b05a9eaa61edc60f711acdc06d907f7525d6197c/docs/architecture.md#L106 has17 crate rows against25 workspace members, omitting mts,tuning,midi,clap-scan,plugin-scan,diagnostics,stream,preferences; dependency rows omit current approved edges. README:38–40 describes six warp modes/beat anchoring, while https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/b05a9eaa61edc60f711acdc06d907f7525d6197c/README.md#L228 through244 emphasizes schema11 historical migrations and calls warping/beat anchoring future at236–237. Public current writer emits schema33 through DocumentV33 (hex-storage/src/lib.rs:133–136, schema/tuning.rs); schema.rs:2061 onward dispatches33 and rejects30–32. Version24 is an intermediate DTO, not public writer output. docs/features.md Projects row also says29. Describe actual supported-reader dispatch from owning source. README project map/dependency paragraph and docs/reference-project.md describe older pre-editable foundations. Source/architecture guard/current crate READMEs are the authority.

Proposed change: bounded current-state README/architecture/reference-project orientation refresh against Cargo metadata, check-architecture.py, current writer/decoder, implemented canonical project/session/render paths and docs/features.md. Clearly label historical evidence and keep useful provenance; do not rewrite historical verification as present success. Correct current capabilities,25crate inventory/important edges and reference adaptation status; prefer links to owning docs instead of duplicating detailed histories.

Boundaries: prose only; no production refactor, schema/version/reader removal, settings/database/user-media changes, reference study, new dependency or expanded device scope. Active alpha policy permits breaking changes but does not initiate migration cleanup. Preserve meaningful native/listening gaps and exact historical release/check evidence.

Acceptance: every workspace crate appears or is explicitly linked from one coherent map; important actual boundary edges match manifests/guard; current emitted format and supported-reader statements match source; warp/beat-anchor/canonical editor status no longer contradicts itself; historical migration facts labeled historical rather than current obligations. Reference adaptation table no longer says canonical snapshots/edits are merely planned where implemented. All changed local links resolve and claims carry owning pointers. No new runtime qualification/native acceptance claims.

Verification: compare25 member inventory using cargo metadata --no-deps --locked and architecture policy/READMEs; source-backed review of writer/decoder and stated capabilities; changed links/whitespace/editorial check and repository prose merge plan. No full native rebuild needed solely for this prose change.

Dependencies: none; can proceed independently of fixture repair after implementation approval. Existing completed #2173 covered older instrument-ordering orientation, not this current drift; retain its history. No duplicate open ticket found in475-ticket audit.

Independent review correction: public encode is schema33 (lib.rs:133–136), not intermediate24. schema.rs:2061 onward dispatches33 and rejects30–32. docs/features.md Projects row still says29; include that row in this same prose refresh. Preserve actual supported-reader dispatch rather than inferring it from version numbers.
